dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Sin grows calm when it hears the Hymn.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: So we let it hear the Hymn. And strike while it listens.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Hey, that's what I said, ya? More or less.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Nuh-uh! I said it first! Way first!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Neither of you said it

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Anyway! Shelinda is telling everyone.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: When a flying ship goes over, all of Spira sings.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Speakers on. Let the whole sky hear it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: Sin! There! Brother sees it first! Brother!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: We get inside it. Through the mouth, if it opens.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: And if it won't, we make our own way in.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Hmph.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: Tidus. My sister...

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: You will look after her. Yes?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Yeah. I will.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: Good! Now I fly! Everybody hold on to something!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Listen! Down there... they really are singing

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: All of Spira. The same song, for once.
Tidus throws Yuna's sphere from Gagazet over the rail.
Yuna watches it fall. Then she smiles.
Sin answers. The air folds inward, then bursts apart.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Kimahri
dboxTimeline.text: Sky is falling toward it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: There! Something shines at the base of that arm!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: It pulls us! We are being pulled in!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Then we hit it where it shines. Hang on!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Cid! Take us in close!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Give me a second!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: The core's glowing! Something's coming!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Get the ship out of reach.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Cid! Back us off!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Hold your horses!
The Fahrenheit's cannon tears the fin away.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: One arm down! Now the other side!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Other side? It has two of those?!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Cid! Take us in close!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Give me a second!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Cid! Back us off!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Hold your horses!
The second fin tears away. The main gun sparks and dies.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Gun's broken! Everybody inside, now!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: No. We've got the ball now.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Nobody hands it back at a time like this.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Ya. I was hoping you would say that.
Wakka jumps onto Sin. One by one, the rest follow.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: It guards the core. Mind it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: It is hiding. The core is waking!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Now. The core.
Sin plows into the outskirts of Bevelle as the sun goes down.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: It is not over. It will rise again.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Yeah. So we beat the one inside it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Then I fix the gun. Nobody touch anything.
